title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Location: Swiss Cottage

Position Type: Full-Time

Department: Finance & Operations

Company Overview

Our client is a dynamic investment firm focused on identifying and managing strategic growth opportunities across diversified sectors. We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Accounts Assistant to join our growing finance team and support our day-to-day accounting operations.

Position Summary

The Accounts Assistant will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records, managing transactional accounting, and supporting month-end closing processes. Working closely with the Finance Manager, you will ensure high efficiency in accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger operations.

Key Responsibilities

1. Accounts Payable & Receivable
- Process, verify, and code supplier invoices and expense reports accurately.
- Prepare payment runs and manage supplier statement reconciliations.
- Issue sales invoices, monitor accounts receivable, and perform credit control follow-ups as needed.

2. Banking & Reconciliations
- Perform daily bank reconciliations across multiple accounts and currencies.
- Reconcile corporate credit cards and petty cash transactions.

3. Month-End & Financial Support
- Assist in preparing monthly trial balances, accruals, prepayments, and journal entries.
- Support the preparation of quarterly VAT/tax returns and compliance filings.
- Assist with audit preparation and liaise with external auditors as needed.

4. Administrative & Operational Finance
- Maintain clean, organized digital records and financial documentation.
- Respond promptly to internal and external accounting queries.
- Support ad-hoc financial reporting and operational projects as directed.

Qualifications & Requirements
- Education & Certifications: Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (or working towards AAT/ACCA/CIMA or regional equivalent qualification).
- Experience: 3 years of experience in an Accounts Assistant or Finance Administrator role (investment management or financial services background is a plus).
- Software Skills: Proficiency with accounting software
- Skills & Competencies:
- High attention to detail and strong numerical accuracy.
- Solid understanding of core bookkeeping principles.
- Strong time management and ability to prioritize tasks to meet deadlines.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

£30,000 - £35,000 Durham (Bowburn) Full Time Permanent

Reed Accountancy & Finance are delighted to be supporting a well-established and highly respected business in Durham with the recruitment of an Accounts Assistant. This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious finance professional to join a successful and growing organisation, working within a supportive finance team and gaining exposure to a broad range of accounting responsibilities.

The Role

As Accounts Assistant, your responsibilities will include:
- Maintaining accurate accounting records across multiple joint venture companies
- Preparing and posting journals, including accruals, prepayments and intercompany transactions
- Raising sales invoices and processing customer receipts
- Monitoring outstanding balances and supporting credit control activities
- Performing bank reconciliations and investigating discrepancies
- Posting receipts, payments and month-end intercompany transactions
- Reconciling balance sheet control accounts and resolving reconciling items
- Assisting with the preparation of monthly management information and reporting
- Investigating and resolving accounting discrepancies to maintain the integrity of financial records
- Supporting VAT reporting and compliance processes
- Maintaining accurate audit trails and assisting with year-end audit requirements
- Reconciling intercompany balances and partner loan accounts
- Supporting continuous improvement initiatives across the finance function
- Providing assistance to colleagues across the wider finance team when required

About You

To be considered for this opportunity, you will possess:
- AAT qualification or be actively studying towards ACCA, CIMA or ACA
- Previous experience in a finance or accounting role with exposure to month-end processes
- A strong understanding of double-entry bookkeeping and core accounting principles
- Experience preparing journals, balance sheet reconciliations and assisting with management accounts
- Experience with bank reconciliations, VAT returns and intercompany accounting
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, lookups and pivot tables
- Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to build effective working relationships
- A proactive and problem-solving approach to finance

Desirable Experience
- Experience within construction, property development or housebuilding sectors
- Experience accounting for joint ventures or multiple legal entities
- Experience using ERP or accounting systems such as COINS, Sage or Microsoft Dynamics
- Knowledge of CIS and construction-related VAT regulations
- Previous involvement in year-end audit preparation and statutory reporting

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £30,000 - £35,000
- Opportunity to join a highly successful and growing North East business
- Varied role with exposure to multiple entities and a broad range of accounting responsibilities
- Supportive and collaborative finance team environment
- Ongoing professional development and study support opportunities
- Excellent career progression prospects within a large and established organisation

To find out more or to apply, please contact Reed Accountancy & Finance today.
